description: This file defines the interface for the CCSP Message Bus Service, including function prototypes for message bus engagement, initialization, finalization, resource management, and signaling, specifically related to WiFi management in an embedded Linux environment.
external_methods: BOOLEAN waitConditionReady(void*, const char*, char*, char*)

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WiFi MBI with user data.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the WiFi MBI with user data.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a bus check operation with user data.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources with specified priority and user data.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_SendParameterValueChangeSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal indicating a parameter value has changed.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_RegisterToCR
methods.description: Registers to a configuration repository with object handle and parameter array.

methods.name: waitConditionReady
methods.description: Checks if a condition is ready on the message bus for specified components and paths.

calls: BOOLEAN waitConditionReady(void*, const char*, char*, char*)
